investment_strategy: Cautiously bullish AI-core portfolio for the next 12–18 months. Anchor in low-to-moderate volatility, cash-generative cloud platforms (MSFT, GOOGL) while adding targeted exposure to AI infrastructure bottlenecks (NVDA GPUs, MU HBM memory) and analog/power management (TXN) to benefit from data center power constraints. Macro backdrop (VIX ~17, 10Y ~3.8%, indices trending higher) supports moderate risk-on sizing, but valuation and regulatory/geopolitical risks warrant capped allocations to high-vol names. Rebalance quarterly; tilt more defensive if VIX >20 or 10Y >4.5% or if AI capex ROI signals weaken.

final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Core low-volatility anchor with best-in-class ROE and strong buy consensus; balances portfolio risk while capturing platform AI upside.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: AI platforms + infrastructure with risk-aware sizing; balance growth momentum with cash-flow quality and analog/power diversification.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Screened for lower volatility first, then strong fundamental growth (earnings/revenue), positive momentum (speed/trend), and supportive analyst consensus; layered in news themes (AI adoption, onshoring, regulation, power constraints) and macro (VIX ~17, 10Y ~3.8%) to size risk.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously bullish: Generative AI remains a powerful secular driver across cloud, semis, and devices. Expect episodic volatility from valuations, antitrust/AI regulation, export controls, and data center power constraints. Favor diversified exposure across platforms (MSFT, GOOGL), GPUs (NVDA), memory (MU), and analog/power (TXN).
